messages:
Lina (Events): Microphone in room B lost phantom power, audio drop for ~30s. Can we shift the Q&A to the last 20 minutes and loop in the remote attendees for questions via thread?
Mason (Studio Tech): Swapped to wired backup mic, rebalanced gain. Audio feed back to normal. Reminder to note the gap in the recording.
Amir (CTO): For fairness, prioritize remote questions first in the resumed Q&A. Also ask presenters to repeat any attendee question aloud before answering.
Host Bot: Announced pause: "Audio glitch detected, switching to backup mic. We'll resume in 2 minutes and move Q&A to the last 20 minutes. Remote attendees please drop questions here."
Recorder Bot: Added event marker at 00:08:12, noting audio fallback in meta: {fallback: "wired-mic-room-b"}
Lina (Events): Post-meeting: I'll add a brief note in the recording description about the audio gap and list timestamps.
Mason (Studio Tech): Uploading the isolated audio from backup mic to s3://redwood-allhands/audio/3325704567/backup-mic.wav
Amir (CTO): Thanks. Priority to remote questions noted. Host, please start with remote Qs when we resume.
Lina (Events): Resuming in 90s.
